material.description: User invariant 3: when AGENTS.md exceeds 30 KB, review all notes, memories, the whole AGENTS.md and all git commit logs, and compile a fresh AGENTS.md with the most relevant, most compact notes, dropping stale memories and notes. AGENTS.md is about 32.5 KB after comment-sweep-rust-crates (7bbaffa6). Acceptance: AGENTS.md under 30 KB; every fact kept is still relevant and factual; no code-expressible comment moved in; CI green on the pushed sha.
